newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AGS B.V. to handle Swisscargo from Sept.
newsitem.headline: AGS B.V. to handle Swisscargo from Sept.

text.p: Aero Ground Services B.V.(AGS) will provide ground handling for Swisscargo from September 1, AGS marketing manager, Eric Gregory told Reuters.
Swisscargo, part of Swissair, operates three flights a day between Zurich and Amsterdam Schiphol Airport with a Saab 340.
Until September, Swisscargo will remain with Cargo Service Centre, which is a subsidiary of KLM Royal Dutch Airlines.
In early 1997 AGS won the contract to handle both Swissair/Sabena trucking operations. The Swiss carrier took over the Belgian carrier's cargo operations last year.
Two daily trucking services leave from Schiphol, one for Zurich and one for Brussels.

"Swisscargo wanted one handling company for cargo and the aircraft handling was a natural step after the trucks. Perhaps in the future they may want one handler for passengers and cargo," Gregory said.
